  - [destroy] -> opposite: preserve or create. The natural antonym of "destroy" is "preserve" or "protect." In this context, the closest clear opposite is "preserve."

Note: There can be some ambiguity with antonyms depending on nuance. "Avoid" can be antonymed as "engage" (as used above) or "face." "Destroy" antonym is commonly "preserve" or "protect." I chose the most straightforward opposites for a coherent sentence.
